_comment: Arr-level truth table: what a REAL Radarr/Sonarr must report for each fork op. Regex-level tests (RegexMatrix/FlipMatrix) are necessary but NOT sufficient — the arr parser normalizes titles before custom formats run (e.g. Radarr rewrites 'Blu-ray' to 'Bluray', which silently defeats regex-only reasoning). Every op that claims a behaviour change must have an entry here. Verified by scripts/arr_verify.py.

cases.title: Snowdrop.2021.E01.SBS.1080p.HDTV.H264-KOREAN
cases.note: Korean SBS broadcaster is not stereoscopic | ARR-LEVEL NOTE: the 3D format is radarr-only and is not synced to Sonarr at all, so TV broadcaster titles were never at risk in practice.

cases.title: Interstellar.2014.1080p.BDRemux.AVC.DTS-HD.MA.5.1-HDCLUB
cases.note: joined BDRemux must be detected as remux | ARR-LEVEL NOTE: upstream ALSO matches Remux here — Radarr detects BDRemux via its own quality modifier, so the title-regex gap never changed arr behaviour for this class.

cases.title: The.Beekeeper.2024.HDRip.x264-EVO
cases.note: EVO non-WEB is the fake-source class

cases.title: Air.Force.One.1997.PROPER.BluRay.1080p.TrueHD.Atmos.7.1.AVC.HYBRID.REMUX-FraMeSToR-AsRequested
cases.note: hybrid marker + retag tag on one real title

cases.title: American.Reunion.2012.EXTRAS.1080p.BluRay.H264-RMXTRAS
cases.note: Extras ban was unmatchable before the wiring fix | ARR-LEVEL NOTE: upstream also matches — Profilarr filters conditions by arr_type on sync, so Radarr only ever receives the Movie Extras condition. The both-required deadlock does not occur in the real pipeline.

cases.title: Movie_2026_1080p_BluRay_TrueHD_7_1_Atmosphere_GROUP
cases.note: Atmosphere must not read as an Atmos marker

cases.title: Pusher.II.2004.DANiSH.1080p.BluRay.x264.TrueHD7.1.Atoms-ADDICTION
cases.note: evidenced TrueHD 7.1 Atoms typo really is Atmos

cases.title: Movie.2023.GERMAN.DL.1080p.BluRay.x264-GRP
cases.note: genuine German dual-language must stay banned | ARR-LEVEL NOTE: upstream matches this too (their op 209)

cases.title: Movie.2023.GERMAN.WEB.DL.x264-GRP
cases.note: German + WEB-DL is not dual-language | ARR-LEVEL NOTE: upstream already excludes it (their op 209), so this fork op changes nothing

cases.title: Love.Actually.2003.2160p.UHD.Blu-ray.DV.x265.10bit.DTS-HD.MA.5.1-HDS
cases.note: Blu-ray DV has a fallback | ARR-LEVEL NOTE: upstream excludes it too — Radarr rewrites Blu-ray to Bluray before CF evaluation, so this fork op changes nothing

cases.title: Movie.2023.2160p.WEB-DL.DV.HEVC-GRP
cases.note: true fallback-less DV control must still match
